'''Haruku''' is an [[Austronesian languages|Austronesian language]] spoken on [[Haruku Island]], just east of [[Ambon Island]] in eastern [[Indonesia]], part of a [[dialect chain]] around [[Seram Island]].

Each villages, Hulaliu, [[Pelauw dialect|Pelauw]], Kailolo, and Rohomoni–Kabauw, is said to have its own dialect.
